sources.title: Model AI Assignments
sources.snippet: Model AI Assignments is the largest, open-access, peer-reviewed AI assignment repository. Accepted assignments are presented in sessions at the Educational Advances in Artificial Intelligence Symposium, collocated with AAAI.

sources.title: GitHub - AtharvaJoshi2004/Artificial-Intelligence: AI Lab Submissions ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains assignments for the course CAUA31201: Artificial Intelligence. The course covers various key aspects of AI, including search strategies, knowledge representation, reasoning under uncertainty, expert systems, and machine learning. The objective is to provide students with a deep understanding of AI concepts and their practical applications in real-world scenarios.

sources.title: AI With Python Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: This AI with Python tutorial covers the fundamental and advanced artificial intelligence (AI) concepts using Python. Whether we're a complete beginner or an experienced professional this tutorial will help us to learn AI step by step.
